scope: Corollary 1.5 (Upper disorder-chaos scales in zero-field SK) of the manuscript “The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick free-energy limiting law” (preprints/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-free-energy-limiting-law-September-24-2026/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-free-energy-limiting-law-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 217 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4acb0e456988f38e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix β > 1 and n ≥ 2. Put En = {(i, j) : 1 ≤ i < j ≤ n} and M = |En| = n(n − 1)/2, and let g′ be an independent copy of g = (gij)(i,j)∈En in (1.1). Write ⟨·⟩g,h for expectation under the product of that model’s Gibbs laws with disorders g, h, and R = n−1 P i σiτi for the overlap. Thus the replicas are independent conditional on their disorders; E below also averages the disorder and any replacement set. For t > 0, set gt = e−tg + √ 1 − e−2t g′. For an integer 0 ≤ k ≤ M, let A be independent of g, g′ and uniform over the k-element subsets of En. Set gA ij = g′ ij on A and gA ij = gij otherwise. Then E⟨R2 ⟩g,gt ≤ 1 n + 2 Var Fn(β) β2n(1 − e−t) , (1.7) E⟨R2 ⟩g,gA ≤ 1 n + 2(M + 1) Var Fn(β) β2n(k + 1) + Cβn−1/2 , (1.8) for a finite constant Cβ depending only on β. As n → ∞, for tn ≥ 0 and integers 0 ≤ kn ≤ M, these bounds imply tnn2/3 → ∞ =⇒ E⟨R2 ⟩g,gtn → 0, (kn/M)n2/3 → ∞ =⇒ E⟨R2 ⟩g,gAn → 0, where An has size kn as above.
